shared.tagline.en: Know the wait before you walk in.
shared.tagline.text: Konnen tan datant la anvan ou antre.

shared.footer.copyright.en: © 2026 PickupRadar. Independent and not affiliated with Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat.
shared.footer.copyright.text: © 2026 PickupRadar. Endepandan epi li pa gen rapò ak Uber Eats, Deliveroo oswa Just Eat.

shared.scale.estimate.en: No recent reports? PickupRadar may show {likelyFast} or {likelySlow}:
shared.scale.estimate.text: Pa gen nouvo rapò? PickupRadar ka montre {likelyFast} oswa {likelySlow}:

home.meta.title.en: PickupRadar (Pickup Radar): pickup wait times for delivery drivers in the UK
home.meta.title.text: PickupRadar (Pickup Radar): tan datant pou pran kòmand pou chofè nan Wayòm Ini

home.meta.description.en: See how long drivers wait at restaurants and shops before you go in. For Uber Eats, Deliveroo and Just Eat drivers in the UK. No sign-up needed.
home.meta.description.text: Wè konbyen tan chofè yo ap tann nan restoran ak boutik anvan ou antre. Pou chofè Uber Eats, Deliveroo ak Just Eat nan Wayòm Ini. Pa bezwen enskripsyon.

home.meta.imageAlt.en: PickupRadar. Know the wait before you walk in.
home.meta.imageAlt.text: PickupRadar. Konnen tan datant la anvan ou antre.

home.hero.lede.en: Do you deliver for Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat? See recent pickup waits at restaurants and shops. Avoid long waits. Tap {reportWait} and earn {radarPoints}. No sign-up needed.
home.hero.lede.text: Ou ap fè livrezon pou Uber Eats, Deliveroo oswa Just Eat? Wè dènye tan datant yo nan pwen pou pran kòmand nan restoran ak boutik. Evite yon long tann. Tape {reportWait} epi touche {radarPoints}. Pa bezwen enskripsyon.

home.hero.cities.en: Now in Milton Keynes. London is next.
home.hero.cities.text: Kounye a nan Milton Keynes. Apre sa, London.

home.hero.apps.en: The iPhone and Android apps are coming soon.
home.hero.apps.text: Aplikasyon iPhone ak Android yo ap vini byento.

home.example.aria.en: Example PickupRadar Home screen with the {nearby} tab open, showing pickup points coloured by their wait
home.example.aria.text: Egzanp ekran dakèy PickupRadar ak onglet {nearby} ouvè. Pwen pou pran kòmand yo gen koulè selon tan datant la

home.example.banner.en: Example screen: sample waits, not live driver reports
home.example.banner.text: Ekran egzanp: tan datant egzanp, pa rapò chofè an dirèk

home.example.caption.en: Example screen. These are sample wait times, not live reports. {live} with real data.
home.example.caption.text: Ekran egzanp. Sa se tan datant egzanp, pa rapò an dirèk. {live} ak done reyèl.

home.try.tab.en: {lead} Use {nearby} to find pickup points close to you when location is on. Use {fast} and {slow} to check waits and estimates.
home.try.tab.text: {lead} Sèvi ak {nearby} pou jwenn pwen pou pran kòmand toupre ou lè lokalizasyon an limen. Sèvi ak {fast} ak {slow} pou gade tan datant ak estimasyon.

home.try.searchLead.text: Chèche yon pwen pou pran kòmand.

home.try.search.en: {lead} Try a name, area or postcode, like KFC or Bletchley.
home.try.search.text: {lead} Eseye yon non, yon zòn oswa yon kòd postal, tankou KFC oswa Bletchley.

home.try.openLead.text: Ouvri yon pwen pou pran kòmand.

home.try.open.en: {lead} The {reportWait} screen opens. Choose a wait time. Nothing is sent.
home.try.open.text: {lead} Ekran {reportWait} la ouvri. Chwazi yon tan datant. Anyen pa voye.

home.signals.title.en: What you can see before you go in
home.signals.title.text: Sa ou wè anvan ou antre

home.signals.intro.en: You see the same labels in the app. Drivers report them, not the delivery apps.
home.signals.intro.text: Ou wè menm etikèt yo nan aplikasyon an. Se chofè yo ki rapòte sa, pa aplikasyon livrezon an.

home.signals.current.body.en: Drivers choose a wait time. You see the current wait and how many drivers reported it in the last 2 hours.
home.signals.current.body.text: Chofè yo chwazi tan datant la. Ou wè tan datant kounye a a ak konbyen chofè ki rapòte li nan 2 dènye èdtan yo.

home.signals.likely.body.en: Shown only when there are no recent reports. These are estimates, not live reports.
home.signals.likely.body.text: Li parèt sèlman lè pa gen nouvo rapò. Se yon estimasyon, pa yon rapò an dirèk.

home.signals.closed.body.en: Drivers tap {reportProblem} to report this. You see their report before you drive there.
home.signals.closed.body.text: Chofè yo tape {reportProblem} pou rapòte sa. Ou wè rapò a anvan ou kondwi ale la.

home.signals.missing.title.text: Pwen pou pran kòmand ki manke oswa ki pa bon

home.how.intro.en: Three easy steps. Reporting takes a few seconds.
home.how.intro.text: Twa etap fasil. Rapòte a pran kèk segonn.

home.how.step1.body.en: No password. The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You don't need to sign up.
home.how.step1.body.text: Pa gen modpas. Aplikasyon an ba ou yon pwofil Radar otomatikman. Ou pa bezwen enskri.

home.how.step2.body.en: Find the pickup point. See the current wait, or {likelyFast} or {likelySlow} if there are no recent reports.
home.how.step2.body.text: Jwenn pwen pou pran kòmand lan. Wè tan datant kounye a a, oswa {likelyFast} oswa {likelySlow} si pa gen nouvo rapò.

home.how.step3.body.en: After you collect the order, tap {reportWait}. It takes seconds. Your report helps other drivers, and you earn {radarPoints}.
home.how.step3.body.text: Apre ou fin pran kòmand lan, tape {reportWait}. Sa pran kèk segonn. Rapò ou a ede lòt chofè, epi ou touche {radarPoints}.

home.points.neededHelp.en: An eligible pickup point near you with no recent wait and no {likelyFast} or {likelySlow}. You earn 15 RP for the report instead of 10.
home.points.neededHelp.text: Yon pwen pou pran kòmand ki kalifye toupre ou, san nouvo tan datant, epi san {likelyFast} oswa {likelySlow}. Ou touche 15 RP pou rapò sa a, olye de 10.

home.cities.body.en: These are the UK cities in the app. Can't find your city? Request it in the app. Or tap {notify} on a {comingSoon} city. We'll email you when it's live.
home.cities.body.text: Men vil Wayòm Ini yo nan aplikasyon an. Ou pa wè vil ou a? Mande li nan aplikasyon an. Oswa tape {notify} sou yon vil ki {comingSoon}. Nou voye yon imèl lè li an dirèk.

home.trust.title.en: Not part of any delivery app
home.trust.title.text: Li pa fè pati okenn aplikasyon livrezon

home.trust.body.en: PickupRadar is independent. It is not part of Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat or any other delivery app. It never uses your accounts with them.
home.trust.body.text: PickupRadar endepandan. Li pa fè pati Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat oswa okenn lòt aplikasyon livrezon. Li pa janm itilize kont ou la.

home.trust.loginLead.text: Pa gen koneksyon nan aplikasyon livrezon an.

home.trust.login.en: {lead} We never ask for your Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat username or password.
home.trust.login.text: {lead} Nou pa janm mande non itilizatè oswa modpas Uber Eats, Deliveroo oswa Just Eat.

home.trust.detailsLead.text: Pa gen detay kliyan oswa kòmand.

home.trust.details.en: {lead} No names, addresses or order numbers.
home.trust.details.text: {lead} Pa gen non, adrès oswa nimewo kòmand.

home.faq.account.a.en: No. The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You can report waits straight away. To protect your {radarPoints}, add your email later. No password needed. The app emails you a 6-digit code.
home.faq.account.a.text: Non. Aplikasyon an ba ou yon pwofil Radar otomatikman. Ou ka rapòte tan datant touswit. Pou pwoteje {radarPoints}, ajoute yon imèl pita. Pa gen modpas. Aplikasyon an voye yon kòd 6 chif pa imèl.

home.faq.download.q.en: When can I download the app?
home.faq.download.q.text: Kilè mwen ka telechaje aplikasyon an?

home.faq.download.a.en: The iPhone and Android apps are coming soon. For now, the {preview} shows real Milton Keynes pickup points and waits.
home.faq.download.a.text: Aplikasyon iPhone ak Android yo ap vini byento. Pou kounye a, {preview} montre vrè pwen pou pran kòmand ak tan datant nan Milton Keynes.

home.faq.track.q.text: Èske li swiv kote mwen ye?

home.faq.track.a.en: No background tracking. The app uses your location while you use it, to show nearby pickup points and check you are at a pickup point when reporting. The website asks for location only when you choose to use it. Read the {privacy} for more.
home.faq.track.a.text: Pa gen swivi an aryè plan. Aplikasyon an itilize kote ou ye pandan w ap itilize li, pou montre pwen pou pran kòmand toupre yo epi verifye ou nan pwen pou pran kòmand lan pandan w ap rapòte. Sit la mande kote ou ye sèlman lè ou chwazi itilize li. Li {privacy} pou plis enfòmasyon.

app.meta.title.text: Preview aplikasyon an an dirèk — PickupRadar

app.meta.description.en: Try the PickupRadar app with real Milton Keynes data. Look around, search for pickup points and see the report screen.
app.meta.description.text: Eseye aplikasyon PickupRadar ak done reyèl Milton Keynes. Gade ozalantou, chèche pwen pou pran kòmand epi wè ekran rapò a.

app.hero.lede.en: This is PickupRadar with real Milton Keynes data. Look around. Search for a pickup point and open it. Nothing you tap here is sent. You can only report in the mobile app.
app.hero.lede.text: Men PickupRadar ak done reyèl Milton Keynes. Gade ozalantou. Chèche yon pwen pou pran kòmand epi ouvri li. Anyen ou tape isit la pa voye. Ou ka rapòte sèlman nan aplikasyon telefòn nan.

app.preview.aria.en: Full PickupRadar app preview with real Milton Keynes data
app.preview.aria.text: Preview konplè aplikasyon PickupRadar ak done reyèl Milton Keynes

support.meta.description.en: Get help with PickupRadar: contact support, report a pickup point problem, and find answers about your Radar profile, {radarPoints} and deleting your account.
support.meta.description.text: Èd PickupRadar: kontakte sipò, rapòte yon pwoblèm nan yon pwen pou pran kòmand, epi jwenn repons sou pwofil Radar, {radarPoints} ak efase kont.

support.hero.lede.en: Need help? Email us about the app, a pickup point, your {radarPoints} or your privacy.
support.hero.lede.text: Bezwen èd? Voye yon imèl sou aplikasyon an, pwen pou pran kòmand, {radarPoints} oswa konfidansyalite ou.

support.contact.body.en: Email us for help, ideas, pickup point problems or privacy questions:
support.contact.body.text: Voye yon imèl pou èd, lide, pwoblèm nan pwen pou pran kòmand oswa kesyon sou konfidansyalite:

support.address.note.en: For letters only. Email is the fastest way to reach us.
support.address.note.text: Pou lapòs sèlman. Imèl se fason ki pi rapid pou kontakte nou.

support.include.body.en: If you report a problem, please tell us:
support.include.body.text: Si w ap rapòte yon pwoblèm, di nou:

support.include.name.text: Non pwen pou pran kòmand lan

support.include.area.en: The area or postcode, if you know it
support.include.area.text: Zòn oswa kòd postal, si ou konnen li

support.include.phone.en: Your phone model, if the app has a problem
support.include.phone.text: Modèl telefòn ou, si pwoblèm nan se aplikasyon an

support.topics.profile.body.en: The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You do not need to log in to use PickupRadar or earn {radarPoints}. Adding your email is optional. It protects your {radarPoints} if you change or reset your phone. No password needed. The app emails you a 6-digit code.
support.topics.profile.body.text: Aplikasyon an ba ou yon pwofil Radar otomatikman. Ou pa bezwen konekte pou itilize PickupRadar oswa touche {radarPoints}. Ajoute yon imèl se yon opsyon. Li pwoteje {radarPoints} si ou chanje oswa reset telefòn ou. Pa gen modpas. Aplikasyon an voye yon kòd 6 chif pa imèl.

support.topics.points.body.en: You earn {radarPoints} for valid wait reports ({waitRp}, or {neededRp} when it says {reportNeeded}), a first report bonus ({firstRp}) and pickup points we approve ({approvedRp}). You can invite a driver from {profile}. You both need protected Radar accounts (add your email). Your friend enters your code before their first valid wait report. When your friend makes 3 valid wait reports, on at least 2 different days (UTC time), at 2 different pickup points, you each earn {referralRp}. {rewards} You can't redeem {radarPoints} yet.
support.topics.points.body.text: Ou touche {radarPoints} pou rapò tan datant valab ({waitRp}, oswa {neededRp} lè li ekri {reportNeeded}), bonis premye rapò a ({firstRp}) ak pwen pou pran kòmand nou apwouve ({approvedRp}). Ou ka envite chofè depi {profile}. Nou toude bezwen yon kont Radar pwoteje (ajoute yon imèl). Zanmi ou antre kòd ou a anvan premye rapò tan datant valab la. Lè zanmi ou fè 3 rapò tan datant valab, nan omwen 2 jou diferan (lè UTC), nan 2 pwen pou pran kòmand diferan, chak moun touche {referralRp}. {rewards} Ou poko ka echanje {radarPoints}.

support.topics.messages.body.en: {profile} has {messages}: announcements, alerts and personal messages for your city or Radar profile. Old or removed messages may no longer appear.
support.topics.messages.body.text: {profile} gen {messages}: anons, alèt ak mesaj pèsonèl pou vil ou oswa pwofil Radar ou. Ansyen mesaj oswa mesaj yo retire ka pa parèt ankò.

support.topics.delete.body.en: Delete your account in the app: {profile} → {deleteAccount}. Or email {email}. If you did not add an email, the app shows {deleteProfile} instead. See the {page} page for the steps.
support.topics.delete.body.text: Efase kont lan nan aplikasyon an: {profile} → {deleteAccount}. Oswa voye yon imèl bay {email}. Si ou pa ajoute imèl, aplikasyon an montre {deleteProfile}. Gade paj {page} pou etap yo.

support.topics.missing.body.en: Is a pickup point missing? Tap {suggest} in the app. Is one wrong? Tap {reportProblem}. Or email us and we will check it.
support.topics.missing.body.text: Pwen pou pran kòmand lan pa la? Tape {suggest} nan aplikasyon an. Gen yon bagay ki pa bon? Tape {reportProblem}. Oswa voye yon imèl epi n ap gade.

support.topics.delivery.body.en: PickupRadar does not connect to your Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat or other delivery app accounts. We never ask for your delivery app logins, passwords, account details, customer details or order details. Drivers only share pickup reports, like wait times and pickup point problems.
support.topics.delivery.body.text: PickupRadar pa konekte ak kont Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat oswa okenn lòt aplikasyon livrezon ou. Nou pa janm mande koneksyon, modpas, detay kont, detay kliyan oswa detay kòmand. Chofè yo pataje rapò pou pran kòmand sèlman, tankou tan datant ak pwoblèm nan pwen pou pran kòmand.

support.closer.title.en: Try PickupRadar before the app launches.
support.closer.title.text: Eseye PickupRadar anvan aplikasyon an lanse.

support.closer.body.en: The live preview shows real Milton Keynes pickup points and waits. Reporting and {radarPoints} are only in the mobile app.
support.closer.body.text: Preview an dirèk la montre vrè pwen pou pran kòmand ak tan datant nan Milton Keynes. Rapòte ak {radarPoints} se nan aplikasyon telefòn nan sèlman.

notfound.meta.description.text: Paj sa a pa sou sit PickupRadar la.

notfound.title.text: Paj sa a deyò rada a.
